cli.buildShort: Validate and generate every configured target
cli.checkLong: Never writes, which is what CI runs. Exit 1 means the locales are wrong or the output is stale; exit 2 means loc could not run at all.
cli.checkShort: Validate and confirm the generated output is current
cli.completionLong: Generate the shell completion script for loc. Each shell's subcommand help says how to use the script it prints.
cli.completionShort: Generate the shell completion script for the named shell
cli.errUnknownColor: unknown value {{.Value}} for --color; use auto, always or never
cli.flagColor: when to colour output: auto, always or never
cli.flagLang: render in this language: --lang wins over LOC_LANG, LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES and LANG
cli.flagQuiet: suppress success output; diagnostics are unaffected
cli.flagStrictLint: warnings, and lint keys findings, fail the lint
cli.flagVerbose: include medium and low confidence findings
cli.headingMoreInfo: Use "{{.Command}} [command] --help" for more information about a command.
cli.helpLong: Shows help for any command in loc. Type `loc help [path to command]` for the full text.
cli.lintDuplicatesShort: Exact duplicate contracts, whatever they are named
cli.lintKeysShort: Unused and missing keys, from a source scan
cli.lintLong: Never modifies anything. Merging is a decision, and an ordinary build is not the place to make it.
cli.lintSharedShort: Keys that may belong in a shared namespace
cli.lintShort: Report messages that may be duplicates
cli.rootLong: loc compiles canonical YAML into vue-i18n and go-i18n bundles, typed keys and a build record. Generated output is committed.
cli.rootShort: Compile one canonical locale source into per-target bundles
cli.statsShort: Counts by namespace, target and locale, plus bundle sizes
cli.watchLong: Survives a validation error and keeps watching: a half-typed key is the normal state of a file being edited.
cli.watchShort: Rebuild on every change until interrupted
diag.badPath: could not work out this file's key prefix
diag.bareValue: expected a message or a group, got a bare value. Wrap it as `value: "..."`
diag.emptyTranslation: empty translation; delete the key or translate it
diag.fileTooLarge: file is {{.Size}} MB; the limit is {{.Limit}} MB. Split it into smaller files
diag.goFieldCollision: {{.First}} and {{.Second}} both become .{{.Field}} in Go, so one silently wins
diag.noPluralRule: no plural rule for this locale
diag.override: a later root overrides an earlier definition
diag.placeholderTypeMismatch: the placeholder {{.Name}} has a different type across locales
diag.placeholderUndeclared: the placeholder {{.Name}} is used but not declared under placeholders
diag.placeholderUnused: the placeholder {{.Name}} is declared but never used
diag.pluralArgumentType: plural argument {{.Name}} is declared as {{.Kind}}; it counts, so it must be an integer
diag.pluralCategoryExtra: {{.Locale}} has no {{.Category}} category, so that form is unreachable
diag.pluralFormMissing: {{.Locale}} needs a {{.Category}} form; without it that band silently renders another case
diag.valueAndPlural: a message is either `value` or `plural`, never both
report.checkModified: loc cannot prove it wrote these, so build will not touch them; remove them by hand:
report.checkStale: generated output is stale; run `loc build`:
report.lintClean: loc: every declared key is referenced, and every reference resolves
report.lintDynamicHint: A key built at runtime looks unused. Declare it under dynamicKeys rather than deleting it.

report.lintHidden.one: {{.Count}} lower-confidence finding hidden; see `loc lint shared --verbose`
report.lintHidden.other: {{.Count}} lower-confidence findings hidden; see `loc lint shared --verbose`

report.lintNoScanRoots: loc: no scan roots configured; nothing to compare against
report.lintReasonContract: the text matches in every locale, but the placeholder or plural contract differs
report.lintReasonDefaultOnly: only {{.Locale}} matches; the other locales differ
report.lintReasonDescriptions: the descriptions differ, so these may be two concepts that coincide
report.lintReasonOneLocale: only one locale is configured, so matching text proves nothing
report.lintReasonTargets: the targets differ, so these are rendered by different runtimes
report.waitingForLock: loc: waiting for another loc run to finish

report.watchWatching.one: loc: watching {{.Roots}} root; ctrl-c to stop
report.watchWatching.other: loc: watching {{.Roots}} roots; ctrl-c to stop
